KXNBA3PTCONTEST.note: No markets listed, no rules. Live terms file NBAALLSTAREVENT.pdf is shared with Slam Dunk and All-Star Game, which supports one all_star_weekend_events archetype; the outcome is a shooting skills event with no game script.

KXNBACELEBRITYGAME.note: Celebrity Game rosters are entertainers and retired athletes, so the outcome is not produced by NBA performance or an official NBA decision. Its terms file is NBARISINGSTARS.pdf, a generic exhibition template. Moved to OUT_OF_SCOPE:entertainment_exhibition.

KXNBACUPMVP.note: Rules: 'wins the Pro Basketball Cup Tournament MVP' with a $1/N multi-winner clause. The outcome is a league award selection that is correlated with Cup results, so it belongs in awards_draft rather than series_and_cup.

KXNBAFINALSVIEWER.note: Terms NBAFINALSVIEWER.pdf settle on Nielsen and media-reported audience figures. A pure media-audience measure is OUT_OF_SCOPE:audience_viewership. No markets listed, so the NO_LISTING basis at medium confidence is honest.

KXNBAFINALSVIEWERGAME7.note: Same NBAFINALSVIEWER.pdf terms and Nielsen settlement source. Series length only decides whether a Game 7 exists; the settling quantity is a TV audience, so it is out of scope as audience_viewership.

KXNBAFIRST50PTS.note: Rules: a first-passage event across all players in the regular season with same-day ties. The season_stat_markets review explicitly models max-over-candidates and special season outcomes, so no new archetype is needed.

KXNBAGAMEHIGHSCORE.note: Rules: any regular-season game (OT included) with 325+ combined points. This is a season-extreme 'special season outcome' covered by the season_stat_markets mechanism (aggregation form = maximum over games).

KXNBAGAMESPECIALS.note: Rules: any player with 15+ steals plus blocks in any regular-season game. This is an on-court season special, so the move out of off_court_events into season_stat_markets is correct.

KXNBAH2HBENCHPTS.note: Bench points is a team aggregate (non-starter scoring) and is not a player stat. game_overtime_and_team_events names 'team bench points' and 'team A stat vs team B stat' in its target and models bench minutes and bench rate. Terms BASKETBALLH2H.pdf are shared with the team 3PT H2H series.

KXNBAH2HTEAM3PT.note: A team-stat head-to-head on made threes. The game_overtime_and_team_events target explicitly covers 'team A stat vs team B stat', and all earlier proposals agree. No markets are listed, so basis NO_LISTING.

KXNBAHALLOFFAME.note: Rules: announced as an inductee to the Naismith HoF class. A committee election (not media awards voting), but it is still an official honours selection decided on career performance. A single series does not justify a new archetype; awards_draft is the closest fit.

KXNBAHIGHESTSCORING.note: No markets listed; terms ENTITYOUTCOME.pdf; title says which player has the season's top single game. An argmax of per-game maxima across players, the same family as KXNBAPLAYERHIGHSCORE in season_stat_markets, at low confidence.

KXNBALASTTOLOSE.note: Rules: the last undefeated team, measured by the day of first loss, with $1/N ties. A run-length process is an explicit stage ('Streak and run-length processes') of season_stat_markets.

KXNBAMVPCHAMP.note: Rules: YES if the regular-season MVP wins the championship. The MVP leg is nearly fixed by the end of the regular season and most of the variance comes from the title leg, so season_futures_team at medium confidence is reasonable.

KXNBANEXTCONTRACT.note: Terms NBACONTRACT.pdf settle on the signing team and media reports. Contract value comes from free agency and cap mechanics, which the off_court_events stages generate (feasibility under cap and apron rules, actor incentives, deal stages). The transaction family has only 3 series, so no new archetype.

KXNBANEXTTEAM.note: Rules: the next team before a date, with a Retires/No Team outcome and a stay-put clause. The destination of a trade or signing is generated by off_court_events' cap-feasibility, actor-incentive and deal-stage pipeline, whose label names transactions.

KXNBANEXTTEAMCONF.note: Terms NBANEXTTEAMCONFERENCE.pdf. A conference aggregation of KXNBANEXTTEAM's destination process, so it belongs in off_court_events. No markets are listed, so NO_LISTING at medium confidence is honest.

KXNBANHL.note: The final archetype is kept, but the reasoning is corrected: NHL is one of the eight supported sports, so the NHL leg is not out of scope. Rules make it a joint of two independent championship futures; parlay_combo handles multi-leg joint resolution.

KXNBAONE3PT.note: Rules: makes at least 1 three in the regular season. A season accumulation of games played times attempt rate, which is the season_stat_markets mechanism (games played, per-game rate); it is not availability.

KXNBAOT.note: Rules: 'at least 1 overtime period is played', with 48h postponement and fair-price void. This is the regulation-tie event modelled in game_overtime_and_team_events, and both proposals agree.

KXNBAPLAYERHIGHSCORE.note: Rules: the player scores 54+ in any regular-season game including OT. The season_stat_markets review cites this exact series under the maximum aggregation form.

KXNBAPLAYERSPECIALS.note: No markets listed; terms NBAPLAYERSPECIALS.pdf with no text. The sibling KXNBAGAMESPECIALS is an on-court season special, so season_stat_markets at low confidence is a fair placement, and off_court_events is wrong.

KXNBAPLAYOFF3D.note: Terms NBAPLAYOFFWHOSTAT.pdf: a playoff 'who records a triple-double' contract. The event generator is the per-game triple-double probability (player_milestones) times playoff games played. season_stat_markets is defined on the regular season, so it is a poor fit.

KXNBAPTSALLGAMES.note: Terms file is NBASERIESSTATS.pdf, the series stat template. 'Points in every game' is a conjunction over a random-length playoff series, which is the series settlement structure modelled in player_h2h_series_stats, not a single-game ladder.

KXNBASERIESOT.note: Terms NBASERIESOVERTIME.pdf. P(any OT in series) = 1 - prod(1 - p_tie per game); the core quantity is the regulation-tie density from game_overtime_and_team_events, and that review explicitly names this series. Both earlier proposals agree.

KXNBASERIESPTSLEADER.note: Terms NBASERIESPOINTSLEADER.pdf. An argmax of player point sums over a random-length series, which matches player_h2h_series_stats ('series total', random series length). Two series do not justify a new series_stat_leader archetype.

KXNBASERIESREBLEADER.note: Shares NBASERIESPOINTSLEADER.pdf terms with the points leader. A series accumulation argmax over rebounds, which player_h2h_series_stats covers through the dependence and random-series-length stages.

KXNBASLAMDUNK.note: Terms NBAALLSTAREVENT.pdf are shared with the 3PT Contest and All-Star Game. A judged dunk contest has no game script or ballot, and the all_star_weekend_events archetype (still 3 members after the Celebrity Game moves out) fits.

KXNBASTATAVG.note: Rules: per-game average with no qualification minimum, zero games treated as an average of zero, and the rounded figure used. The season_stat_markets review cites exactly these clauses.

KXNBASTATLEADER.note: Rules: leads the NBA in total plus/minus for the regular season, with a traded-player clause. This is accumulation and a leader race, not a vote, so season_stat_markets is correct.

KXNBATOP5ROTY.note: Terms NBADRAFTROTY.pdf with NBWA/AP sources suggest 'top-5 draft pick wins ROTY'. Either reading is an awards_draft outcome, and low confidence is right without rules text.

KXNBAUNBEATEN.note: Terms NBAPLAYOFFUNDEFEATED.pdf. Going 16-0 requires four consecutive sweeps, so the outcome is the product of series sweep probabilities, the series-length/sweep mechanism named in the series_and_cup target. It is not a seed or win-total future.

KXNBAWINSTREAK.note: Rules: any team wins 20 straight regular-season games, with Cup games counting. This is a run-length process covered by the season_stat_markets streak stage.

KXNBACELEBRITYGAME.reason: The All-Star Celebrity Game is played by entertainers and retired athletes. Its winner does not come from NBA player performance or an official NBA decision, so it is entertainment programming. The terms file is a generic exhibition template (NBARISINGSTARS.pdf). Unverified: no markets were listed when contract rules were sampled, so no rules text is available; settlement details (DNP, ties, period) are not confirmed.

KXNBAH2HBENCHPTS.reason: Bench points is a team aggregate (points by non-starters), so a head-to-head compares two teams' bench output in a game. game_overtime_and_team_events covers team bench points and team-stat pairs; player_h2h_series_stats does not. Shares BASKETBALLH2H.pdf terms with KXNBAH2HTEAM3PT. Unverified: no markets were listed when contract rules were sampled, so no rules text is available; settlement details (DNP, ties, period) are not confirmed.

KXNBANHL.quote: Toronto Pro Basketball team and the Washington NHL team win
KXNBANHL.reason: Two-leg joint contract: a named NBA champion AND a named Stanley Cup champion; the NO side wins as soon as either team is eliminated. The legs are near-independent season futures of two supported sports (NBA, NHL), so this is a multi-leg joint resolution rather than a single team future.

KXNBAPLAYOFF3D.reason: Playoff triple-double 'who stat' contract (terms NBAPLAYOFFWHOSTAT.pdf). The outcome comes from per-game triple-double probability (player_milestones) aggregated over the random number of playoff games the player's team plays. season_stat_markets is regular-season accumulation. Unverified: no markets were listed when contract rules were sampled, so no rules text is available; settlement details (DNP, ties, period) are not confirmed.

KXNBAPTSALLGAMES.reason: The terms file is the series stat template (NBASERIESSTATS.pdf), so this is likely a player reaching a points threshold in every game of a playoff series. That is a conjunction over a random-length series with within-series dependence, which is the series structure in player_h2h_series_stats. Unverified: no markets were listed when contract rules were sampled, so no rules text is available; settlement details (DNP, ties, period) are not confirmed.

KXNBASERIESOT.reason: Series overtime (terms NBASERIESOVERTIME.pdf) settles on whether any game in a series goes to OT. That is 1 - prod(1 - p_tie) over the games played, so the core is the per-game regulation-tie density from game_overtime_and_team_events, with series length as an exposure input. Unverified: no markets were listed when contract rules were sampled, so no rules text is available; settlement details (DNP, ties, period) are not confirmed.

KXNBAUNBEATEN.reason: A team going undefeated through the playoffs (terms NBAPLAYOFFUNDEFEATED.pdf) must win four best-of-seven series 4-0. That is the product of per-series sweep probabilities, the series-length/sweep mechanism in series_and_cup, not a seed or win-total future. Unverified: no markets were listed when contract rules were sampled, so no rules text is available; settlement details (DNP, ties, period) are not confirmed.

out_of_scope_categories.entertainment_exhibition: Exhibition entertainment events staged around the NBA whose participants are celebrities or non-NBA performers (e.g. the All-Star Celebrity Game), so the outcome is not produced by NBA performance or an official NBA decision.
